column1: # Raw bytes are the decoded command bytes the emulated PM IR FIFO hands to the original firmware (logical IR_KEY 3DA9).
# A function without an entry cannot be delivered (no invented codes). Fill in only evidence-backed values; see docs/ir-input-path.md.
# Digits: raw 0x01..0x09 -> app codes 0x11..0x19, raw 0x45 -> app 0x10 (docs/ir-raw-to-app-key-table.tsv); the original handler 8046DA24..8046DB2C computes value*10+(app-0x10).

column3: app 0x11 = digit 1 (8046DA24 numeric entry; run s15: raw 1 -> app 0x11 -> OSD 17 digit banner)
app 0x10 = digit 0 (static: table 0x8061773C, raw 0x45; not yet exercised in a connected run)
BEHAVIOURAL: app 0x29; the original firmware opens its main menu (OSD 1, Picture page, first item highlighted, four-arrow hint) - runs m1/m2/m3, evidence/menu-diagnostic/, docs/ir-key-sweep.md
BEHAVIOURAL: app 0x0B; with the menu open the highlight moves one item down (Picture Mode -> Color Temperature -> Aspect Ratio) - runs m2/m3
BEHAVIOURAL: app 0x0C; with the menu open the page tab moves left (Picture -> Lock, wrapping because the antenna tab is disabled) - run m2
BEHAVIOURAL: app 0x0F; with the menu open the page tab moves right (Picture -> Sound -> Setup, Lock -> Picture) - runs m2/m3
BEHAVIOURAL: app 0x0D; with the menu open on Picture it opens the item panel (rows with slider bars) - run m2
